Set a table for a briefing or report

Source: R/profile.R
btg_table.Rd

Formats a data frame for the document being knitted, in the style the package's briefings use: an HTML table that the briefing stylesheet lays out, a Word table that takes the reference document's table style, or a booktabs table in PDF. Numeric columns are right-aligned and text columns left-aligned unless align says otherwise. Outside a knitting session it returns a plain Markdown table.

Usage

btg_table(x, caption = NULL, align = NULL, digits = 1)

Arguments

x

A data frame.

caption

Optional caption.

align

Optional alignment string or vector as knitr::kable() takes it, one letter per column.

digits

Number of decimal places for numeric columns.

Value

A knitr_kable object, printed by knitr into the document; in PDF the table is set one size smaller than the text.

Examples

btg_table(head(btg_get_data("national_year")$data[c("year", "stops", "arrest_rate")]),
          caption = "National totals")
#> 
#> 
#> Table: National totals
#> 
#> | year|  stops| arrest_rate|
#> |----:|------:|-----------:|
#> | 2018| 319569|        15.7|
#> | 2019| 524424|        12.8|
#> | 2020| 676628|        11.4|
#> | 2021| 541523|        12.2|
#> | 2022| 477044|        12.8|
#> | 2023| 449005|        14.0|
